title: Control flow
description: Compares, flags, and conditional branches in NASM
theory:
## Branches on x86-64

The `cmp` instruction subtracts for flags only; combine it with **conditional jumps** (`je`, `jne`, `jg`, `jl`, …) to implement `if` / `else`.

This chapter stays on **`_start` + syscalls** (no libc required).

exercises.title: Pick a branch
exercises.description: If `rax` holds `7`, print `T` else print `F` (single character, no newline), then exit 0.
exercises.starter_code:
global _start
section .data
    t: db 'T'
    f: db 'F'
section .text
_start:
    mov rax, 7
    ; cmp / jmp to pick one byte write of length 1
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall
hints: `cmp rax, 7` then `je` to a label that points `rsi` at `t`
Reuse one `write` syscall block after choosing `rsi`
exercises.solution:
global _start
section .data
    t: db 'T'
    f: db 'F'
section .text
_start:
    mov rax, 7
    cmp rax, 7
    lea rsi, [rel f]
    jne skip
    lea rsi, [rel t]
skip:
    mov rax, 1
    mov rdi, 1
    mov rdx, 1
    syscall
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall

exercises.title: Count-down loop
exercises.description: Use a loop in `.text` to print exactly three stars `***` (no newline) with three single-character writes or one write of length 3 from a buffer you fill.
exercises.starter_code:
global _start
section .bss
    buf: resb 3
section .text
_start:
    ; store '*' '*' '*' into buf then write syscall rdx=3
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall
hints: `mov byte [buf], '*'` then bump index in a register
Or place `db '*','*','*'` in `.data` and write once
exercises.solution:
global _start
section .data
    stars: db '*', '*', '*'
    slen equ $ - stars
section .text
_start:
    mov rax, 1
    mov rdi, 1
    mov rsi, stars
    mov rdx, slen
    syscall
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall

exercises.title: Signed compare
exercises.description: If `eax` is **less than** `0` (signed), print `N`, else print `P` (one character, no newline), then exit 0. Initialize `eax` to `-3`.
exercises.starter_code:
global _start
section .data
    n: db 'N'
    p: db 'P'
section .text
_start:
    mov eax, -3
    ; jl vs jge to pick letter
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall
exercises.solution:
global _start
section .data
    n: db 'N'
    p: db 'P'
section .text
_start:
    mov eax, -3
    cmp eax, 0
    lea rsi, [rel p]
    jge pos
    lea rsi, [rel n]
pos:
    mov rax, 1
    mov rdi, 1
    mov rdx, 1
    syscall
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall

exercises.title: Unsigned compare
exercises.description: Set `rbx` to `10`. If `rbx` equals `10`, print `Y`, else print `N` (one character, no newline), then exit 0.
exercises.starter_code:
global _start
section .data
    y: db 'Y'
    n: db 'N'
section .text
_start:
    mov rbx, 10
    ; cmp rbx, 10 then pick y or n
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall
exercises.solution:
global _start
section .data
    y: db 'Y'
    n: db 'N'
section .text
_start:
    mov rbx, 10
    cmp rbx, 10
    lea rsi, [rel n]
    jne skip
    lea rsi, [rel y]
skip:
    mov rax, 1
    mov rdi, 1
    mov rdx, 1
    syscall
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall
